sub_goals.text: Hospital orders recorded accurately and confirmed promptly
kpis: Order lines matching the hospital purchase order
>= 99.5% per month
Order confirmation sent after submission
within 15 minutes
beliefs: Each hospital has a contract price list
Hospital buyers order through the portal or the assistant
constraints: A confirmed order cannot be changed without a change request

sub_goals.text: Batch and expiry traceable to each hospital
kpis: Shipped lines with batch number and expiry date recorded
Time to list every hospital that received a recalled batch
under 2 hours
beliefs: Good distribution practice requires batch records for every medicine
constraints: A line without batch and expiry cannot be shipped

sub_goals.text: Cold-chain products kept within their temperature range
kpis: Cold-chain shipments with a continuous temperature log
Temperature excursion alerts acknowledged
within 30 minutes
Goods with an excursion released without a quality decision
beliefs: Vaccines and insulin need 2 to 8 degrees Celsius
constraints: Only the Quality Assurance Officer may release goods after an excursion

sub_goals.text: Access to order, stock, and contract data verified for every request (zero trust)
kpis: Requests authenticated and authorized per request
Privileged actions protected by multi-factor authentication
Quarterly access reviews completed
beliefs: No network location, including the office network, is trusted by default

sub_goals.text: Personal data of hospital staff and named patients protected
kpis: Personal data fields classified with a documented purpose
Patient identifiers stored outside named-patient order records
Data subject requests closed
within the legal deadline
beliefs: Named-patient orders contain a patient name and medical record number
constraints: Patient identifiers are not sent to the language model provider

sub_goals.text: Ordering assistant governed as an AI system
kpis: Assistant answers that cite an approved source
Hospital-specific prices disclosed to another hospital in the monthly audit
Answers rated correct in the monthly evaluation
Model and prompt changes approved before release
beliefs: The assistant runs on an external model provider
constraints: The assistant cannot place or change an order without the buyer's confirmation
Patient identifiers are not sent to the language model provider
